suggestion.title: Unafungua {{channel}} haraka zaidi
suggestion.body_one: Kati ya arifa zako {{total}} za haraka za hivi karibuni, ulifungua {{count}} kwanza kwenye {{channel}}, kwa kawaida baada ya dakika {{minutes}}.

suggestion.accepted: Sawa. Arifa za haraka sasa zitaenda kwa {{channel}} kwanza.
